annotations.title: Browse the official RFB RTC tables (free, no payment)

description: Returns the reference data behind the calculator at no charge: the table-set metadata, the full 2026 to 2033 transition schedule with nominal CBS and IBS rates per year, the headline sector reductions with their cClassTrib code and the LC 214/2025 article that grants them, every accepted sector alias, and the official Simples Nacional activity list. Passing a cClassTrib code instead resolves that single classification. Use it to discover which classifier to send to calculate_rtc_official, to validate a code before pricing, or to explain a reduction with its legal basis. Do not use it to tax an amount, which calculate_rtc_official does, or to produce a document, which generate_danfse_rtc does. This is the only free tool on this server: it needs no x402 payment and no API key, is read-only, idempotent and fully offline, and an unknown code returns HTTP 404 with success:false and a null result rather than an exception.

cClassTrib.description: Optional 6-digit cClassTrib code to resolve on its own, for example '200046'. Omit it to receive the complete table set instead of a single record.

name: rtc_lookup_official_tables

keyReductions.description: Headline sector reductions, one entry per sector. Returned only when cClassTrib is omitted.

artigo.description: Article of LC 214/2025 that grants the reduction.

cst.description: CST code tied to the classification.

setor.description: Sector alias you can pass as setor.

metadata.description: Official table-set provenance: version, publication date, normative reference, licence, record counts and source engines.

result.description: The single resolved classification record. Present only when cClassTrib was supplied; null when the code was not found.

sectorAliases.description: Every sector alias the engine accepts in the setor field. Returned only when cClassTrib is omitted.

simplesActivities.description: Official Receita Federal Simples Nacional activity records, each with its code, description and the annex to apply with and without Fator R. Returned only when cClassTrib is omitted.

success.description: true when the tables were returned, or when the requested cClassTrib was found. false with HTTP 404 when a supplied code does not exist.

transitionSchedule.description: Map keyed by year from 2026 to 2033. Each entry carries year, cbsNominal, ibsUfNominal, ibsMunNominal, ibsTotalNominal, totalNominal, icmsIssReductionPct, phase, isTestYear and legalBasis, all rates in percent. Returned only when cClassTrib is omitted.
